استرفدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْفَدُوا (istarfadū) /is.tar.fa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَرْفَدَ (istarfada)
# اُسْتُرْفِدُوا (usturfidū) /us.tur.fi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْفَدَ (istarfada)
# اِسْتَرْفِدُوا (istarfidū) /is.tar.fi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْفَدَ (istarfada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
